articles.body: Turn one, elephant looks at Delhi from Maratha. Peace event comes up, both regions receive a tower level and the 5 order opens in Delhi, but does the Elephant move? Next card on the stack is Maratha, triangle. Does the elephant move to face Bengal (Maratha's triangle border)? Following this the final Events in India card is also a Resolve Crisis +3. Does Maratha take over Bengal? What did I do wrong?

articles.body:
[q="Maltsensation"]Turn one, elephant looks at Delhi from Maratha. Peace event comes up, both regions receive a tower level and the 5 order opens in Delhi, but does the Elephant move?[/q]
Yes. Page 31, [b]Peace[/b], points out that in any case the event triggers an Elephant's March.

[q="Maltsensation"]Next card on the stack is Maratha, triangle. Does the elephant move to face Bengal (Maratha's triangle border)?[/q]
It depends. If Maratha is dominated by an empire (in turn 1 of the 1710 scenario it is, I don't recall the other two), then the March would leave the Elephant in the same place. If Maratha is sovereign, the Elephant points to Bengal. If Maratha is Company-controlled, the Elephant goes to the centre of the region.

[q="Maltsensation"]Following this the final Events in India card is also a Resolve Crisis +3. Does Maratha take over Bengal? What did I do wrong?  [/q]
As before, it depends. If Maratha was dominated by an empire, no, Maratha fights against Delhi. If Maratha is sovereign, Maratha takes Bengal, and a new empire forms. If Company-controlled, rebellion!
